children: Ark Invest sold about $25 million of Palantir Technologies
shares last week, placing the artificial-intelligence software company among the larger technology positions trimmed by Cathie Wood's investment firm.

The reduction came as Ark reshaped exposure across its portfolios, with the firm also cutting holdings in Shopify and Advanced Micro Devices. At the same time, Ark directed new capital into space, financial technology, biotechnology and crypto-related investments.

Palantir's sale stands out because the company has been a prominent growth and AI holding for investors focused on software and emerging technology. The transaction indicates that Ark was willing to reduce part of that exposure while committing funds elsewhere.

For Palantir, the sale could draw attention from investors who track Ark's trading decisions as a gauge of growth-stock sentiment. Still, one week of portfolio activity offers limited evidence about Palantir's operating outlook and does not by itself establish a bearish view on the shares. The move is better viewed as portfolio management than direct commentary on Palantir's revenue, demand or competitive position.

title: Cathie Wood Dumps $25 Million of Palantir Shares. Should PLTR Investors Worry?
